verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product where users build automations. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a category error for this kind of offering. The firm's internal use of AI and automated translation does not mean it ships a user-facing automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
